_comment: TRUE GCC = M365 GCC paired with COMMERCIAL Entra/Azure. Endpoints are the SAME worldwide URLs as commercial (graph.microsoft.com / api.security.microsoft.com). Deploy this into the customer's GCC-paired commercial Azure subscription. If the customer is ever GCC High/DoD instead, switch graphBase to https://graph.microsoft.us, mdeResourceBase/mdeAudience to the .us Defender endpoints, and deploy in Azure Government (az cloud set --name AzureUSGovernment).
